persons.name: Bhairavīśaraṇa
persons.evidence: idaṃ pustakaṃ bhairaviśaraṇena (!) lipikṛtaṃ svapaṭhanārthaṃ kāśyāṃ madhye

notes: Scribe name written 'bhairaviśaraṇena' (!), normalized to Bhairavīśaraṇa, matching catalogue. Saṃkaṭādevī and Vidyeśvara are deities/shrines (Saṅkaṭā temple and Vidyeśvara/Śiva in Kāśī), not persons. No date in colophon.
